title: Gradient estimates for the Lagrangian mean curvature equation with Lipschitz critical phase
summary: Let $n\ge3$. We prove a priori interior gradient estimate for the Lagrangian mean curvature equation \[ \sum_{i=1}^n\arctanλ_i(D^2u)=θ(x) \] under the critical and supercritical phase condition $θ\ge (n-2)π/2$, assuming only that the Lipschitz norm of the prescribed phase is bounded.
